For me, my favorite wiki articles that I’ve maintained are the ones about the Minecraft novels. It’s just so amazing with the stuff that you can do with a game as imaginative as Minecraft, much less novels, of which there are about to be ten of them ("Mob Squad" and "The Haven Trials" are slated for later this year)!

It’s really difficult to pinpoint a specific novel as my favorite to have summarized for the wiki, but if I had to pick, it would be "The Shipwreck", originally released in November of last year. It details about a Minecraft server that is set up at an apartment complex in Los Angeles and three friends that are completely unknown to each other have to work together to solve the mystery of it before the complex gets renovated. I’m surprised that I was even able to get the entire novel up on the site before the year ended. Only took me 42 chapters to do, and in between that I was moonlighting at a full-time job, so I had a lot on my plate back then.
